whoWeAre.heroSubtitle: A clearer path to studying in Germany, with guidance that explains each step and everyone's responsibilities
whoWeAre.imageAlt: A calm and professional DARB working environment

story.title: A path begins when the next step is clear
story.body: DARB was built around a practical need: turning a process full of information, documents, and decisions into a route students can understand and manage

chapters.title: Start by listening
chapters.body: Before suggesting a route, we understand the student's academic background, goals, and constraints

chapters.title: Organize the process
chapters.body: We divide the route into clear stages, explain what each one requires, and identify who is responsible for each decision

chapters.title: Stay reachable
chapters.body: When circumstances change or a question appears, the student knows who to contact and what needs to happen next

direction.title: A practical ambition, not a grand promise
direction.missionTitle: Make every next step understandable and organized
direction.missionBody: We help students gather information, prepare documents, and follow their progress without losing sight of the whole process
direction.visionBody: We want students to approach international study understanding their options, costs, responsibilities, and the institutions that make official decisions

principles.title: Principles you can see in practice
principles.body: Our values are measured by how we communicate, document, and follow each case

items.title: Listen before advising
items.body: No two students have the same background or circumstances
items.practice: We begin with the student's details, not a ready-made answer

items.title: Explain who decides
items.body: Admission, visas, and recognition belong to official institutions
items.practice: We clearly separate DARB's guidance from decisions made by authorities and institutions

items.title: Keep the work organized
items.body: A long process is easier when stages and documents remain visible
items.practice: We track progress, tasks, and payments in one place

items.title: Remain reachable
items.body: Important questions should not disappear between stages
items.practice: We direct each question to someone who knows the case and can explain the next step

team.title: One team, clear responsibility
team.body: Our work brings together guidance, document preparation, follow-up, and support. Every enquiry has a clear owner, and the team works from the same case record and shared context
